description: Keeps your equipped gear visible during the death animation.
body:
# Gear On Death

Keeps your equipped gear visible during the death animation.

---

### Information

This mod keeps a player's full gear - armor, mainhand, and offhand - visible during the death animation instead of it disappearing instantly when items are dropped.

Each gear slot can be individually toggled through the config screen, accessible via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu).

**Client-side**

This mod is **client-side only** and works on any server.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Required |
|---|---|
| [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | ✔ |
| [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) | ✔ |
| [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | ✔ |
